title: Define resolved agent-assignment configuration and API contract
description: Create the canonical, redacted read model for a routing assignment. It must distinguish requested agent-class / agent-provider from effective provider configuration, including provider/product, model, effort, service tier/flex mode, and non-secret arguments. Support user-level defaults with project overrides and deterministic Python/Rust resolution. Expose this through the console snapshot/detail API without leaking tokens or arbitrary command arguments. Add validation and parity tests.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Router attempt 1 returned retryable_failure: no canonical agent-assignment resolver exists yet in either runtime, and there is no defined user-level configuration location/merge contract for the 'user-level defaults with project overrides' requirement. Moving to Blocked pending a scoping decision rather than re-consuming router attempts on the same gap; unblock once scope is narrowed (e.g. project-level config only for a first pass, or the user-level config location is specified).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Moving to Backlog instead of leaving in Blocked: confirmed live that Blocked still consumes router.limits.class_wip capacity even with no active claim, starving daf353 and f954ad behind it — a direct, reproducible instance of the exact bug kbs-f954ad describes. Will pull back to Ready once scope is narrowed.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Scope decision (owner, 2026-09-25): there is no user-level agent configuration in Kanbus and none is wanted. Drop the 'user-level defaults with project overrides' requirement; resolution is project-level only, from router.providers, router.classes and the issue's agent-class or agent-provider label. The console UI for the effective assignment already shipped (PR #331) and reads agent_assignment from the issue, but nothing populates it; this story is the resolver and API that do, in Python and Rust, with redaction and parity tests.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Complete: merged in https://github.com/AnthusAI/Kanbus/pull/371 with CI green. Project-level only, per the owner's scope decision (no user-level defaults). Both runtimes now populate custom.agent_assignment in the console snapshot from the project's router configuration: exactly one valid agent-class or agent-provider label gives {kind, name, provider_profile, effective: {platform, model?, settings?}}, a class resolves to the first provider it lists, and only adapter, model and service tier are exposed. Missing, unknown or ambiguous labels add nothing. The existing issue-detail UI (PR #331) renders it. Also fixed in the same change: the console snapshot was sending the entire router config to the browser including provider env values and args; args are now emptied and env values are [redacted] in both runtimes. Spec: features/specs/console/console_snapshot_agent_assignment.feature (8 scenarios; 4 fail against develop's code, all pass in behave and cucumber), plus unit tests in each runtime.
